sections.Profile:
"The Three Musketeers" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in 1964. Designed for two players, it features two flippers and three pop bumpers.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Fictional Character, Adventure, Book
